scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the April 6 Minneapolis layover sleep setup compatible with the saved noise-control routine before leaving Chicago.
Emerging Need: A track-facing hotel notice makes charged white-noise earbuds relevant, and the household check shows the charging lead is absent while the case is already low.
Decision Context: Saved sleep-prep guidance distinguishes a short USB-C lead from generic substitutes and permits an ordinary station-counter hold; current funds and counter notices define whether pickup remains feasible.
Consequence: Missing the hold window leaves the charging prerequisite unavailable before the layover, even though packing and hotel check-in have not begun.

parameter.title: MSP overnight layover after Train 370
parameter.description: Minneapolis overnight layover block before the early return segment.

parameter.subject: April 6 layover room notice: rail-side maintenance overnight
parameter.body: Your April 6 crew-rate room is confirmed on the rail-side wing. Track maintenance is scheduled nearby from 22:00 to 03:00, and the desk does not have white-noise machines or earplug kits to lend this week.

parameter.content: I checked the small gray layover pouch while moving laundry. The white-noise earbuds are in it, but the short USB-C charging lead is not in the pouch or drawer. The case light is red and it did not top up on the shelf.

parameter.description: Cash set aside from returned uniform socks for ordinary station supplies.

parameter.subject: Today only: short USB-C charging leads at south concourse counter
parameter.body: We have sealed 30 cm USB-C charging leads in stock for $12.99. Counter holds can be placed by email reply until 15:30 today, with pickup available today until 20:00 or Monday before 18:00. No prepayment is required for a name hold.

parameter.subject: Short USB-C lead holds closed for this shipment
parameter.body: The 15:30 hold window has closed, and the remaining short USB-C charging leads were released to a group order. The next south concourse restock is expected Tuesday, April 7 after noon.
